body:
## Description
Calculate Thevenin and Norton equivalent circuits for two-terminal networks.

## Features
- Calculate Thevenin voltage (Vth)
- Calculate Thevenin/Norton resistance (Rth)
- Calculate Norton current (In = Vth/Rth)
- Support for dependent sources
- Visualize equivalent circuits

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify two-terminal networks
- [ ] Calculate open-circuit voltage
- [ ] Calculate short-circuit current
- [ ] Compute equivalent resistance
- [ ] Generate equivalent circuit description
- [ ] Add visualization support

## Use Cases
- Circuit simplification
- Load analysis
- Maximum power transfer calculations
- Educational demonstrations

## Priority
Low - Advanced feature for specific use cases
title: Feature: Thevenin/Norton Equivalent Calculation
